primary_source_rules.kp_ap: NOAA SWPC: K/Kp is nonlinear; convert each 3-hour K to linear a before daily averaging.
primary_source_rules.dst: WDC Kyoto: 9999 is missing; quicklook/provisional/final versions must remain distinguishable.
primary_source_rules.panchanga: Project runtime uses sunrise reference; coefficient remains R&D until prospective validation.
